payload.core_mechanism_summary: Enumerates all 4 possible evaluation trees (a*b*c, a*(b+c), (a+b)*c, a+b+c) and takes maximum. No recursion or pruning needed.
payload.rationale: Selected search_backtracking as the closest complete search subtype; the solution explicitly tests all combinations of operations and parentheses, akin to an exhaustive search without recursion. Other subtypes (bitmask, permutation, branch/bound, dfs/bfs) don't match the direct enumeration used.
